name: webscraping-ai
label: WebScraping AI
description: WebScraping AI is a powerful tool that allows you to scrape websites and extract data.

webscraping_ai_get_html.label: Get Page HTML
webscraping_ai_get_html.description: Returns the rendered HTML of a web page.

url.label: URL
url.description: Full URL of the target page, including the scheme, e.g. "https://example.com/pricing".

headers.label: Headers
headers.description: HTTP headers to send to the target page, as header name → value, e.g. {"Cookie": "session=abc"}.

timeout.label: Timeout
timeout.description: Maximum page load time in milliseconds, 1-25000. Defaults to 10000.

js.label: Render JavaScript
js.description: Render the page in a headless browser. Defaults to true; set false for static pages to save credits.

jsTimeout.label: JavaScript Timeout
jsTimeout.description: Maximum JavaScript rendering time in milliseconds, 1-20000. Defaults to 2000.

waitFor.label: Wait For
waitFor.description: CSS selector to wait for before returning, e.g. ".content-loaded".

proxy.label: Proxy Type
proxy.description: Proxy tier. "datacenter" (default, cheapest), "residential" for sites blocking datacenter IPs, "stealth" for heavily protected sites (most expensive), "auto" tries each tier in turn. "auto" cannot be combined with Custom Proxy.

country.label: Proxy Country
country.description: Country of the proxy used to fetch the page. Defaults to "us".

customProxy.label: Custom Proxy
customProxy.description: Your own proxy URL, e.g. "http://user:password@host:port". Overrides Proxy Type.

errorOn404.label: Error on 404
errorOn404.description: Fail when the target page returns 404. Defaults to false.

errorOnRedirect.label: Error on Redirect
errorOnRedirect.description: Fail when the target page redirects. Defaults to false.

jsScript.label: JavaScript Code
jsScript.description: JavaScript to run on the page after it loads, e.g. document.querySelector("button").click(). The result is the value of the last expression; a top-level "return" is a syntax error.

returnScriptResult.label: Return Script Result
returnScriptResult.description: Return the JavaScript Code result instead of the page HTML. Defaults to false.

webscraping_ai_search_google.label: Search Google
webscraping_ai_search_google.description: Returns parsed Google search results for a query.

countryCode.label: Country Code
countryCode.description: Two-letter country code for the search location (Google gl), e.g. "us". Defaults to "us".

languageCode.label: Language Code
languageCode.description: Two-letter language code for the results (Google hl), e.g. "en". Defaults to "en".

page.label: Page
page.description: Results page number, a whole number from 1 to 100. Defaults to 1.

webscraping_ai_get_structured_data.label: Get Structured Data for a Page
webscraping_ai_get_structured_data.description: Returns parsed structured data for a page on a supported site such as YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn or Reddit.

url.label: URL
url.description: URL of a page on a supported site, e.g. "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ".

country.label: Proxy Country
country.description: Two-letter country code of the proxy used to fetch the page, one of the proxy countries (us, gb, de, it, fr, ca, es, ru, jp, kr, in, hk, tr). Defaults to "us".

transcript.label: Include Transcript
transcript.description: YouTube videos only. Also fetch the video transcript into data.transcript. Defaults to false.

transcriptLanguage.label: Transcript Language
transcriptLanguage.description: YouTube videos only, with Include Transcript. Caption language, e.g. "en" or "de".

webscraping_ai_get_account.label: Get Account Info
webscraping_ai_get_account.description: Returns the account email, remaining credits and concurrency.
